auto_fetch.title: 自动抓取链接预览
auto_fetch.description: 复制单个网页链接后在后台自动抓取标题、简介与封面图；关闭后仅在查看详情或手动刷新时抓取。

en.title: Fetch link previews automatically
en.description: Fetch webpage title, summary, and cover image in the background when a standalone URL is copied.

fetch_favicon.title: 抓取网站图标 (Favicon)
fetch_favicon.description: 在链接卡片中显示来源站点的图标。

en.title: Fetch site favicon
en.description: Show the website icon on link preview cards.

fetch_thumbnail.title: 抓取网页封面图 (og:image)
fetch_thumbnail.description: 默认抓取并压缩网页的 OpenGraph 封面图用于卡片展示。

en.title: Fetch cover image (og:image)
en.description: Fetch and resize the page's OpenGraph preview image by default.

request_timeout_sec.title: 单次抓取超时（秒）
request_timeout_sec.description: 限制单个链接的网页与图片请求总时长。

en.title: Request timeout (seconds)
en.description: Bound total fetch duration for one link.

excluded_domains.title: 排除域名
excluded_domains.description: 不抓取列表中的域名（支持精确域名或 *.example.com 通配）。

en.title: Excluded domains
en.description: Skip fetching URLs under these domains (exact host or *.example.com).
